name: Twilight No More!
summary: Clubtoe asks you to confront Chogg'Zac in the Sunnyglade cave. He blames them for his friends' deaths and their promise to make ogres strong.

sections.title: Clubtoe's Plea
sections.body: Clubtoe says his friends are dead and blames Chogg'Zac. They promised to make ogres strong, but he says they lied. So he asks you to help him turn against them in the Sunnyglade cave. He wants their heads, and he will smash no more rocks for them.

sections.title: A New Name
sections.body: After Chogg'Zac die, Clubtoe cries out in triumph. He says he is done smashing rocks for tinies and done losing friends. He names himself Twilight no more.

faq.answer: Clubtoe is an ogre who says Chogg'Zac promised to make ogres strong. He blames them for his friends' deaths.

faq.q: Why does Clubtoe want Chogg'Zac dead?
faq.answer: Clubtoe says Chogg'Zac lied about making ogres strong and blames them for his friends' deaths.
Chogg'Zac are in the Sunnyglade cave.

faq.q: What does Clubtoe want from you?
faq.answer: Clubtoe asks you to kill Chogg'Zac and collect their heads.

attribution: In-game quest text: Twilight No More!
